original_abstract.text: Learning feature interaction is the critical backbone to building recommender systems. In web-scale applications, learning feature interaction is extremely challenging due to the sparse and large input feature space; meanwhile, manually crafting effective feature interactions is infeasible because of the exponential solution space. We propose to leverage a Transformer-based architecture with attention layers to automatically capture feature interactions. Transformer architectures have witnessed great success in many domains, such as natural language processing and computer vision. However, there has not been much adoption of Transformer architecture for feature interaction modeling in industry. We aim at closing the gap. We identify two key challenges for applying the vanilla Transformer architecture to web-scale recommender systems: (1) Transformer architecture fails to capture the heterogeneous feature interactions in the self-attention layer; (2) The serving latency of Transformer architecture might be too high to be deployed in web-scale recommender systems. We first propose a heterogeneous self-attention layer, which is a simple yet effective modification to the self-attention layer in Transformer, to take into account the heterogeneity of feature interactions. We then introduce \textsc{Hiformer} (\textbf{H}eterogeneous \textbf{I}nteraction Trans\textbf{former}) to further improve the model expressiveness. With low-rank approximation and model pruning, \hiformer enjoys fast inference for online deployment. Extensive offline experiment results corroborates the effectiveness and efficiency of the \textsc{Hiformer} model. We have successfully deployed the \textsc{Hiformer} model to a real world large scale App ranking model at Google Play, with significant improvement in key engagement metrics (up to +2.66\%).
original_abstract.source_title: Hiformer: Heterogeneous Feature Interactions Learning with Transformers for Recommender Systems

en.text: Hiformer adapts Transformer attention to feature fields whose meanings and interaction rules differ. Heterogeneous self-attention models those differences, while low-rank approximation and pruning reduce serving cost. The work addresses both whether generic attention is expressive enough for sparse recommendation features and whether the resulting model can meet online latency constraints.

zh.text: Hiformer 为不同语义的特征字段设计异质自注意力，让字段之间的交互不再完全共用同一种规则。它再用低秩近似和剪枝压低推理成本，同时解决稀疏推荐特征如何有效交互、以及 Transformer 能否满足线上延迟要求的问题。
